title: Normalized additive native underived tensor
statement: For a finite field k0, a prime l different from its characteristic and a k0-scheme X, there exists an additive bifunctor T on native Weil module sheaves, additive also in its second variable. It is parameter-adjoint to the specified ihomBifunctor [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models]. Its underlying ordinary bifunctor is naturally isomorphic to ordinaryTensorBifunctor. For every native map Q to Hom(P,I), composing the inverse underlying comparison with the forgotten inverse adjunction equals ordinary Mod.ihomAdjunction inverse applied to that same underlying map. These are underived sheaf maps, not derived morphisms.

source.place: Native tensor model, geometric tensor part of steps 1 and 3; Stacks 06YS, 06YU, 0FPT

proof.text: Take the source tensorFunctor and tensorIhomAdjunction at each P. For f:P to P-prime define its tensor parameter map to be the inverse mate of ihomBifunctor.map(f.op). The mate identity and composition equations make this a bifunctor; the unit mate equation gives its parameterized adjunction.

source.place: Native tensor model, geometric tensor part of steps 1 and 3; Stacks 06YS, 06YU, 0FPT

proof.text: Both the source units and counits have the ordinary module maps as carriers. Therefore the underlying parameter map is the inverse mate of Mod.ihomMap(f), which is Mod.tensorLeftMap(f). This proves additivity and naturality of the identity underlying comparison. The inverse-adjunction normalization is then the ordinary inverse-adjunction formula by definition.

lean.statement:
theorem native_weil_underived_tensor :
    ∃ T : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X ⥤ ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X ⥤
      ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X,
    ∃ _ : T.Additive, ∃ _ : ∀ P, (T.obj P).Additive,
    ∃ adj : T ⊣₂ ihomBifunctor k₀ l X,
    ∃ e : Functor.uncurry.obj T ⋙
        Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X) ≅
      (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).prod
        (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) ⋙
          Functor.uncurry.obj
            (ordinaryTensorBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber),
    ∀ (P Q I : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X)
      (f : Q ⟶ ((ihomBifunctor k₀ l X).obj (op P)).obj I),
      e.inv.app (P, Q) ≫
          (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).map
            (((adj.adj P).homEquiv Q I).symm f) =
        ((Mod.ihomAdjunction P.carrier).homEquiv Q.carrier I.carrier).symm f.hom.f
